The colloquially named '''Hoth hogs''' were hog-like creatures native to the icy wilderness of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Hoth_Hog_Tusk.jpg|left|thumb|A close-up of a Hoth hog tusk]]
Hoth hogs were an herbivorous, land-scavenging race of hog-like creatures. Rarely seen<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> and physically weak, they were among the lowest forms of life in the planet's food chain, serving as prey to animals such as the [[giant tauntaun]]. They presumably fed on the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] and [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]] that grew just below the frost layer.<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|tauntaun|tauntaun}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HothHog-SSW2.png|thumb|right|200px|The Hoth hog from ''Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'']]
The Hoth hog first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', which was developed by [[LucasArts]] and [[Sculptured Software]], and published by [[THQ]]<ref name="SSW 2">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> on [[June 1]], [[1993]].<ref name="Year By Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref>
